The main takeaway from our work is that

mothers who are having challenges in breast feeding their preterm infant may be able to respond to a galactogouge in the first 3 weeks postpartum, regardless of the number of days postpartum they are at.
mothers of very small preterm infants, who are having a suboptimal milk production, can be treated with domperidone to augment milk production.

mothers of very low birth weight infants, < 1500 g, are able to respond to a galactogogic agent, domperidone, in the same fashion regardless of when they are enrolled in a trial and the timing of the initiation of the treatment.
